A spanning bar renders across the first three day columns. (2) AC-3 non-regression: plain click on col3 with no drag = 9-2-2026 -> 9-2-2026, a ONE-DAY draft, form open. Prior behaviour preserved in the app, not just in the unit test. (3) AC-4 reverse drag col4->col2 = 9-1-2026 -> 9-3-2026, the same normalised 3-day range as a left-to-right drag. (4) AC-5 drag past the right edge from col5 = 9-4-2026 -> 9-5-2026, clamped to the last visible day; no out-of-window date produced. Evidence: screenshots 01-landing, 03-mid-drag, 04-after-release, 05-plain-click, 06-reverse-drag, 07-clamp-edge in the session scratchpad.
